original_text: Sight's clearer now. Much easier to move.
zhtw: 總之能看得見了，駕駛起來順手多了呢。

original_text: Good, we can spot again.
zhtw: 好，又可以繼續搜尋了呢！

original_text: We can see outside again.
zhtw: 外部的情報傳回來了！

original_text: Optics restored. We can see around us now.
zhtw: 觀測裝置修復！這樣就能看到遠方了！

original_text: It's easier when you have your sight back.
zhtw: 視野恢復後就輕鬆多了呢～

original_text: Repairs complete. Resume spotting.
zhtw: 修理完成！重新展開索敵！

original_text: Okay, the optics are healthy again.
zhtw: OK！觀測裝置運作良好！

original_text: Target acquired.
zhtw: 鎖定目標囉。

original_text: Got them.
zhtw: 發現了呢。

original_text: Locked on. They're not getting away.
zhtw: 已經鎖定，絕不讓你逃掉！

original_text: Target confirmed. Let's cook.
zhtw: 確認目標！要怎麼做？

original_text: Target tracked. Let's land it calmly.
zhtw: 捕捉完成！冷靜瞄準命中吧！

original_text: We see them. Now we finish it.
zhtw: 看得到了，剩下的就是搞定它！

original_text: Enemy acquired.
zhtw: 捕捉敵車！

original_text: Lost them. Don't force the chase.
zhtw: 跟丟了呢，不要勉強硬追！

original_text: Target lost. Break off for now.
zhtw: 失去目標！先暫時放棄！

original_text: They vanished, huh. They'll show again.
zhtw: 消失了嗎…算了，之後會再現身的。

original_text: They're out of sight. Look for the next play.
zhtw: 脫離視野了呢，看下一個目標吧。

original_text: Switching targets, got it.
zhtw: 變更目標了呢，收到。

original_text: Drop that one. On to the next.
zhtw: 那邊就放掉吧，換下一個。

original_text: No tunnel vision. Good call.
zhtw: 不深追，這是明智的判斷喔。

original_text: We're moving to another target.
zhtw: 轉向別的目標囉。

original_text: Let's change targets.
zhtw: 來更換瞄準目標吧。

original_text: We can leave that one to others.
zhtw: 那個交給其他人處理就好。

original_text: Let's go for a cleaner shot.
zhtw: 轉向火線角度更好的敵人。

original_text: Target unlocked. Searching for the next.
zhtw: 解除目標，搜尋下一個。

original_text: Priority changed.
zhtw: 優先順序改變了呢。

original_text: Copy, new target.
zhtw: 收到，更換目標。

original_text: Let's leave that target behind.
zhtw: 先放過剛才的對手吧。

original_text: Target switching matters. Read the flow.
zhtw: 切換目標很關鍵！觀察形勢吧！

original_text: Let's leave them be for now.
zhtw: 這邊先暫時擱置吧！

original_text: Tracks took a hit. Should we make a pit stop now?
zhtw: 履帶受損，要進維修站嗎？

original_text: Tracks damaged. No wild moves.
zhtw: 履帶受損，別做勉強的操縱動作。

original_text: Track damaged. We can make an early pit stop.
zhtw: 履帶受損！要提早進維修站嗎？

original_text: They're going for our tracks. Watch out!
zhtw: 對方在瞄準腳程呢，注意！

original_text: Tracks are off! Let's make a pit stop now.
zhtw: 履帶斷了，先進維修站吧。

original_text: They got our running gear! Repair it fast.
zhtw: 腳程被破壞了呢，快點修理！

original_text: Ah, there go the tracks.
zhtw: 啊，履帶被打了斷。

original_text: We can't move like this. Tracks, please.
zhtw: 這樣動彈不得，履帶修理拜託了！

original_text: Tracks restored.
zhtw: 履帶修復。

original_text: Running gear is fixed.
zhtw: 底盤懸吊系統修好囉！

original_text: Track repair complete.
zhtw: 履帶的修理完成！

original_text: Good, they're back on properly.
zhtw: 確實接合上了呢。

original_text: We can move. Let's go.
zhtw: 可以動了！出發！

original_text: Tracks are back. We're rolling again.
zhtw: 履帶修好了！來吧，出發！

original_text: Good, we can roll again.
zhtw: 好，又能繼續跑了！

original_text: There, there. You can move now.
zhtw: 好啦好啦，可以動囉～！

original_text: Thanks for waiting. Let's move.
zhtw: 讓你們久等了，出發吧！

original_text: Still got some running to do.
zhtw: 我們還能跑得更快！

original_text: Okay, let's move again.
zhtw: OK，恢復移動！

original_text: Turret drive is damaged. Traverse is slower.
zhtw: 砲塔旋轉裝置故障了，砲塔很難轉動。

original_text: Turret rotation's sluggish.
zhtw: 砲塔轉動變得很鈍。

original_text: They hit the traverse system. Don't rush it.
zhtw: 旋轉裝置被擊中了，別慌張。

original_text: Turret won't turn. Traverse mechanism destroyed.
zhtw: 砲塔轉不動了！

original_text: Rotator's destroyed!
zhtw: 旋轉裝置大破。

original_text: No good, the turret's stuck.
zhtw: 不行！砲塔動不了了！

original_text: Can't rotate the turret.
zhtw: 沒辦法改變砲塔的方向！

original_text: Turret's turning again.
zhtw: 砲塔可以轉動了！

original_text: Traverse restored. We can realign now.
zhtw: 旋轉裝置修復，可以重新瞄準囉！

original_text: Tow crew, take your time!
zhtw: 回收救援慢慢來沒關係喔～

original_text: The race is over for us, but that wasn't a bad run.
zhtw: 退賽了嗎。不過跑得還算不賴喔。

original_text: Oarai's defensive line has been breached.
zhtw: 大洗防衛線崩潰了！

original_text: Team-Leoponsan here. We're done for, sorry.
zhtw: 這裡是豹獅隊，被幹掉了，對不起喔。

original_text: We'll stay up all night tonight and get those tanks back in running order.
zhtw: 今晚徹夜也要把戰車修到能自力的程度！
